sinopsis.es: Durante un eclipse solar en Misiones, los habitantes de una comunidad experimentan cambios inquietantes en un paisaje marcado por la devastación ambiental.
sinopsis.en: Somewhere in Argentina: as an eclipse of the sun is predicted and the surrounding forest continues to be devastated by logging, only a few women and a little boy are left to fend for themselves. When everything collapses, one clings to the slightest hint of vitality.
